sloka: तानर्दयित्वा बाणौघैस्त्रासयित्वा च वानरान् ।प्रजहास महाबाहुर्वचनं चेदमब्रवीत् ।। ६.४६.२४ ।।।।
transliteration: tānardayitvā bāṇaughaistrāsayitvā ca vānarān ।prajahāsa mahābāhurvacanaṁ cedamabravīt ।। 6.46.24 ।।।।

translations.english: "O Rakshasas! Look at these two brothers together bound by my fierce arrows in front of you."
